Oneliner

Collecting Ship`s AIS message and demonstrate LNA Module.
Description

Demonstrate locally made LNA module in space and AIS transceiver.
Results

As a result of our satellite's 45-day adventure in space, we have received more than a million AIS Messages and visualized more than five hundred thousand AIS Messages by downloading them to the ground station at THK University.

KILICSAT successfully collected over a million AIS messages from ships traversing the seas, showcasing Turkiye's capability to contribute valuable data for maritime safety and navigation.
Notes

Changed from "Undersecretariat for Defense Industries (SSM)" and Aselsan to GUMUSH AeroSpace as the legal owner of the satellite as as per request via email.
